regimeSub: FOMC Day 1 begins with Fed expected to hold at 4% despite 4% CPI; Brent spikes to $111 adding inflation pressure.
themes: FOMC Oct meeting Day 1 underway per Investopedia/PBS → Fed Chair Warsh expected to hold at 4.0% despite Sep CPI 4.0% YoY; markets pricing Dec hike if inflation persists per Reuters 'inflation and weak hiring point opposite directions'
Brent crude +$111 amid Saudi output disruptions per WSJ Sep report → energy adding 30bp to headline CPI; gold $4,059 at ATH signals inflation hedge bid as real rates stay negative at -0.5%
10Y yield flat at 5.00% as Treasury rally pauses per TradingView 'bond rush' story; 2Y -1bp to 4.68% → 2s10s steepens to +32bp as term premium reprices Fed credibility risk
KOSPI +6.1% to 6001 vs last week as foreign flows return; USDKRW +14 to 1338 as won weakens on BOK hold aftermath per Korea Times Oct 22 hawkish stance signaling further tightening ahead

headline: Fed Chair Warsh begins October FOMC with markets pricing a hold at 4% despite 4% CPI, as Brent at $111 and gold ATH $4,059 signal persistent stagflation fears.
